goal: Integrate dau-viet-mobile with the Spring Boot Historical Events API: Timeline lists published events, Event Detail loads the selected event, mock mode stays available behind a flag.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Dio-based EventsApiClient + shared API client; base URL via --dart-define=API_BASE_URL with per-platform defaults; timeouts + typed errors; no infinite retry.
HistoricalEventDto + HistoricalEventRepository abstraction with API impl matching existing structure; type-safe parsing, no rampant dynamic.
Riverpod loading/success/empty/error + retry; no redundant calls on rebuild; state kept across navigation.
Timeline uses GET /api/v1/events; Event Detail uses GET /api/v1/events/{id}; existing design/animations preserved; Bach Dang demo unbroken.
Mock fallback behind explicit flag; never silently substitutes fake data on API failure; clear API vs mock repo separation.
AssetResolver maps coverAssetKey to asset path; image fallback widget; no layout breakage; key not assumed public URL.
Tests cover parsing, success/error, pagination, empty, 404, loading/retry, Timeline->Detail navigation, mock mode, missing-asset widget; flutter analyze + flutter test pass.
Run/config docs updated (API URL per platform, mock flag); no scope creep into auth/admin/learning engine.
